transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I suppose... I just don't have the push I used to have. For things like choir, or... my quilting. I don't really go visiting folks anymore. Most days I just sit at home. I keep the TV on low. I know people are expecting me to come around, but... I just stay put. That's mostly it.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy, like choir or quilting?
Yes... like I was just sayin'. I just don't have the push for 'em no more. I'd rather just sit.
How long have you been feeling this way, without the push to do things you used to enjoy?
A while, I suppose... It's just been building up since I retired. From the school office. That was... a little over two years ago.
Do you feel sad or low most days, or is it more that you just don’t feel like doing things?
I wouldn't say sad. Just... empty, I guess. I don't really feel much of anything. Just don't want to do things.
Do you feel tired or like you don't have any energy most days?
I don't think so. Not tired, exactly... I just don't do much. Energy's alright, I guess.
Do you feel down or like you're in a funk most days?
Not really. Just... what I said a minute ago. Empty, mostly. I wouldn't call it a funk.
Can you tell me more about how you feel when you're not doing the things you used to enjoy, like choir or quilting?

I just... I don't have the push I used to. For choir, or the quilting... or going out to visit folks. Most days I just sit at home. I keep the TV on low. I know people are expecting me to be there, but... I just sit.
Do you still enjoy things that used to make you happy, like watching TV or spending time with loved ones?

I don't know about enjoy. Like I was just saying... the TV is mostly just on. I don't really pay it much mind. And as for folks... I just don't have the push for visiting anymore. Even when I know they're expecting me to. I just... I'd rather just sit.
Do you feel like you're in a low mood or feel down most days, even if it's not exactly sadness?
I don't... no. Not down. Just... like I told you before. Empty. It's not really a low mood. I just don't feel much of anything.
